hypothesis: Stock for WIDGET is 10 shared across OVS-PIECE (1 unit each) and OVS-TWOPACK (2 units each). The confirm step checks each cart line against available stock alone, so entries sharing WIDGET are never added up. Several carts that each take 6 WIDGET units (for example 3 TWOPACK lines of qty 1 in one cart, and a second such cart) should each pass the per-line check and both complete, yielding orders that need more than 10 units.
